matching_policy.unmatched_message: No mobile health threat scenario matched.

scenarios.name: Clinical Deep Link Navigation
scenarios.problem_scenario: Can an external link open a patient or clinical workflow inside the mobile application?
business_indicators: 深度链接打开患者页面
risk_identification: An attacker-controlled deep link may navigate to a sensitive screen with tampered identifiers.
A competing application may hijack an unverified custom URL scheme.
security_control_requirements: Allow only verified HTTPS app links from approved domains.
Require an authenticated and authorized session before opening clinical content.
Validate every deep-link route and object identifier against an allowlist.

scenarios.name: Offline Clinical Data Cache
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the mobile product retain patient or clinical data for offline use?
risk_identification: Clinical data stored on a lost or compromised device may be disclosed.
Cached records may remain accessible after account logout or device reassignment.
security_control_requirements: Encrypt offline clinical data with a device-bound platform key.
Apply a documented retention limit and securely purge data on logout.
Prevent sensitive clinical content from appearing in backups or screenshots.

scenarios.name: Biometric Sign-In
scenarios.problem_scenario: Can users sign in or unlock sensitive clinical data with device biometrics?
risk_identification: Weak biometric fallback may bypass the intended authentication strength.
A stale biometric session may expose clinical data after risk conditions change.
security_control_requirements: Use the platform biometric API and require strong biometric authentication.
Never store or process raw biometric templates in the application.
Require server reauthentication for high-risk actions and after session expiry.
